cases.notes: Dedicated two-Scene RTT implementation: sceneRTT owns one three-entity RenderSet, scene owns one twenty-five-entity RenderSet, and sceneScreen remains a fullscreen exemption. All rendering, RTT sampling, Phong shading, indexed-indirect draws, output conversion, and readback are DSL-owned and ordinary single-sample. Strict evidence: 36/36 quadrant runs, 36/36 cross-quadrant comparisons, and 24/24 stability comparisons passed; worst MAE 0.02116, P99 1, and SSIM 0.9999238613694479.
